title: Companion bars beside a held line

members.role: the line is the world: a panels page lands and draws its line panel alone, whole before anything joins it
the page's first focus state at its own instant: the line active over the region, the bars panel hidden
on the comparison's word a row state makes both active: the line shrinks into its slot, the bars build beside it
a written multiple or gap on the bars panel (a bracket is refused on bars), after the bars have built
on the leave word the focus returns to the line alone: the bars go and the line re-grows over the region (T8c)

does: A line stands alone; on the comparison's word a hidden bars panel turns active beside it, two bars building on the line's one scale and unit; on the leave word the line stands alone again. The window spans the line's hold.

use_when.shape: series + two numbers of the SAME measure, in the line's unit (a panels object: the line, then a hidden bars panel, both naming one `measure`)
use_when.use: the line stays as context while two magnitudes are set against each other beside it - 'today it's twenty-eight ... railways took roughly half'
use_when.dont: the bars cover the plot, ticks or source (E63, E45); the bars in another unit than the line's (re-express them, E79 / E53 s4 WARNs); a companion on a page with no panels (recipe:chart-parks-for-their-claim)

source: P70 T4 (was P69 T52; harvest v2 T39, BRAVOS-USE-WHEN.md:287) - no new grammar: P69 T8b-T8e's panels page with a hidden bars panel revealed on its word; proved as the golden companion-railway-yardstick (tests/test_companion_bars.py) on H row 14's yardstick - offsets span the golden (reveal 9.0, leave 16.2) and row 14's take (22.56, 29.76); no approved cut carries it
